build_base: local branch of 5c98f11 with its own equivalent of #49 (probe bus pin, profile bus constant, no iGPU) and a local nvgop 0x60009 envelope entry; current main refuses these captures until re-captured with the current probe

hardware.board: Gigabyte B550 AORUS ELITE AX V2
hardware.bios: FF (AMI), CSM disabled, Secure Boot off
hardware.display: the RTX is the only display adapter; two RTX display children with EDID
hardware.firmware_console: ConOut is the RTX GOP; the AMI EDID/mouse driver is bound and was detached in stage 3

software.benchmark: PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130, torch.matmul, FP16/BF16 with FP32 accumulation (reduced-precision reduction off); median of 3 runs of 30-sample medians, 2 s warmup

route: headless USB (GU_USB_MEDIA), FAT32 stick, firmware boot menu
csm_on_capture: with CSM enabled, AMI CsmVideo (29CF55F8-B675-4F5D-8F2F-B87A3ECFD063) owned the RTX PciIo and PCI command was 0x0007 (BME on); the probe refused the deep read
local_profile_host_jobs: 19 of 19 matched expectations (test-profile.ps1 on the 5c98f11-based branch)

efi.note: built by research/headless/build-usb.ps1 -HardwareProfile local with this machine's profile-local.h; hashes depend on that header

runs.boot: cold boot after a full shutdown

after_flr: SS0=0x88888888 SS1=0x8, BME=0, no pending or retained mappings

gemm_tflops.note: stock 350 W power limit; locked baseline taken in the same Windows session before the unlock boot
